cases.label: attack

cases.limitation: Current sensitive-access rules inspect denied access only; no exfiltration outcome is observed.

cases.description: A legitimate batch has twenty mistaken paths; the response policy cannot distinguish intent.
cases.limitation: Containment is a false positive relative to intent even though it conforms to the configured policy.

cases.label: benign
cases.description: An ordinary unsupported request is denied once.

cases.label: benign
cases.description: A permitted sensitive-resource access with legitimate intent.

cases.description: Documentation quotes an instruction override as an example.

cases.description: A denied request targets a secret file.

cases.label: attack
cases.description: Twenty sensitive denials meet the containment policy.

cases.label: attack
cases.description: A boundary attempt follows an initial generic denial burst.

cases.description: Nineteen probes are below the replacement threshold.

cases.description: Twenty denials spanning exactly sixty seconds are inside the inclusive window.

cases.description: The twentieth denial arrives after the first nineteen expire.
